preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines.

preconditions.expression: n >= 1 and n <= 100000 and k >= 0 and k <= n
preconditions.description: The integers n and k satisfy 1 <= n <= 100000 and 0 <= k <= n.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'ab' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s has length n and contains only characters 'a' and 'b'.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum beauty achievable by changing at most k characters, which is the maximum of the best results for making a substring of all 'a's or all 'b's.

postconditions.expression: is_valid_beauty(s, k, result, 'a') or is_valid_beauty(s, k, result, 'b')
postconditions.description: There exists a substring of length 'result' that can be made uniform (all 'a' or all 'b') by changing at most k characters.

postconditions.expression: not any(is_valid_beauty(s, k, L, 'a') or is_valid_beauty(s, k, L, 'b') for L in range(result + 1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: No substring of length greater than 'result' can be made uniform by changing at most k characters.
